turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Maya. Good to hear your voice this morning. How are you feeling heading into the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren! I'm doing pretty good, just trying to catch my breath after all that prep earlier in the week.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: You put in some heavy work lately. Did anything shift on your calendar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, actually. Velloway Analytics moved our recruiter screen back to Friday, October ninth at eleven in the morning.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That gives you almost a full week of breathing room. Does that extra space feel helpful or annoying?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A little of both, honestly. I was geared up to get it over with, but now I have time to fix some details in my stories.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A brief pause can be a real gift if you use it right. Which story are you thinking about polishing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, I was looking back over my old slides from the consulting club project.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: I remember that one from our very first conversation. What did you find in your notes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I realized I had the wrong metric in my head earlier. The consulting club result was actually a fifteen percent drop in donor churn once the final quarter's data came in.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Fifteen percent is a solid, grounded number to share with a recruiter. How does it feel saying that out loud?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, it feels much better. Before, I was worried I was misremembering the impact, so having the exact figure makes me feel more confident.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Solid proof takes away the wobble. Do you want to try delivering that line once right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You know what, I think I'd rather just give my voice a rest today and not overthink it.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Resting is part of the work too. What are you doing to unwind today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm meeting a friend for lunch downtown, and then we're going for a long walk near the waterfront without my phone.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds like a great reset. Will you promise to leave the interview notes at home?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haha, I promise. No SaaS talk until Monday morning.
